latest_block.combined_pattern: (?is)(?:มีการใช้บัตร\s+UOB-\d{4}[\s\S]*?วงเงินคงเหลือใช้ได้\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*THB|You have spent[\s\S]*?Available credit:\s*THB\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?|รายการเงิน(?:ออก|เข้า)\s*-?[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*บาท[\s\S]*?ยอดเงินที่ใช้ได้\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*บาท|LINE Pay Purchase[\s\S]*?Balance:\s*(?:THB\s*)?[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
latest_block.selection: Match all supported blocks, then Get Item from List: Last Item
latest_block.classification: Inspect only the selected block for UOB, SCB, or LINE Wallet anchors

sources.block_pattern: (?is)(?:มีการใช้บัตร\s+UOB-\d{4}[\s\S]*?วงเงินคงเหลือใช้ได้\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*THB|You have spent[\s\S]*?Available credit:\s*THB\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)

sources.amount_pattern: รายการเงิน(ออก|เข้า)\s*-?([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*บาท
sources.direction_rule: Group 1 เข้า => credit; otherwise debit

v1_legacy: account_last4 or card_last4 or empty text

v2.strong_identity: v1 material plus transaction_datetime or transaction_reference when present
v2.timeless_identity: v1 material plus a five-minute Bangkok capture-time bucket when neither strong field is present
v2.retry_window: timeless identities dedupe within five minutes; strong identities remain stable across capture time

payload_types.amount: canonical decimal string with exactly two fractional digits
payload_types.transaction_reference: nullable normalized bank/reference identifier, at most 128 characters
payload_types.dedupe_version: integer; server-generated raw captures use 2 and legacy normalized envelopes may use 1

never_post_when: amount is missing or not positive
endpoint or device token still contains a placeholder
